_comment: Shared complexity-classifier corpus. Every prompt is classified by the canonical
browser-extension/content/complexity.js (classifyDetailed) AND by the desktop enforcer's
C# port (ClassifyComplexityDetailed, compiled out of agent/src/os_monitor/enforcer-win.ps1),
and agent/tests/complexity-lockstep.test.mjs requires verdict, rule and score to be identical.
checks it against the canonical classifier. A changed expectation is a billing change.
